sessions.phase_label: Project clarification, deliverable scoping, and content handoff
Initial magazine layout and editorial feedback
Layout revision, asset remediation, and flipbook preparation
Final corrections, digital delivery, and source-file handoff

requirements.title: Magazine Layout Structure
requirements.definition: Create the magazine template and arrange the supplied articles, images, and advertisements into a cohesive issue following the applicable flat plan and editorial order.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers page structure, article flow, and flat-plan arrangement; visual branding, typography, metadata, individual required pages, and output formats remain independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Brand-Aligned Visual Style
requirements.definition: Present the magazine with a polished, modern visual style aligned with the publication website's branding.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the overall brand and visual direction, not independently changing font, color, metadata, or whitespace rules.

requirements.title: Readable Article Body Typography
requirements.definition: Use an article-body typeface and weight that are readable, sufficiently substantial, and visually suitable for the modern magazine layout.
requirements.boundary_note: Typeface family and weight are attributes of one typography mechanism; other visual-style rules remain separate.

requirements.title: Article-End Whitespace Balance
requirements.definition: Avoid conspicuous empty areas at article endings by balancing affected pages with appropriate article-related images or other approved editorial elements.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently testable page-balance outcome and approved filler treatment; general image resolution and unrelated content inclusion are separate.

requirements.title: Cover-Only Red Usage
requirements.definition: Reserve red for the magazine cover and do not use it for the Elon Musk article layout.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a specific color-use constraint that can be changed independently of the overall brand style.

requirements.title: Article Author Attribution
requirements.definition: Display the correct author's name and a small circular photograph with every article.
requirements.boundary_note: Author name, photograph identity, circular treatment, and display size are attributes of one attribution mechanism; category labels are independently required.

requirements.title: Article Category Labeling
requirements.definition: Identify each article's applicable editorial category with a visually integrated label.
requirements.boundary_note: Category labeling can be correct or modified independently of author attribution and article titles.

requirements.title: Website Article Sourcing
requirements.definition: Source the magazine's article content directly from the specified publication website.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the source of article content, not the separate requirement to include particular omitted articles or pages.

requirements.title: Inclusion of Cover-Listed Articles
requirements.definition: Include the articles listed on the cover even when they are absent from the flat plan, with placement selected to preserve the magazine structure.
requirements.boundary_note: The three omitted articles are required items within one inclusion correction; their exact placement is an attribute rather than three separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Tribute Page Placement
requirements.definition: Include the supplied tribute page near the end of the magazine.
requirements.boundary_note: The tribute is a distinct required content unit with its own placement rule.

requirements.title: Advertise Page Inclusion
requirements.definition: Include the designated publication advertising-information page in the magazine.
requirements.boundary_note: This concerns presence of one required page, not the visual clarity and sizing of third-party advertisements.

requirements.title: Cover Page-Number Accuracy
requirements.definition: Ensure the cover displays correct page numbers for every article featured on it.
requirements.boundary_note: Cover references can be wrong while the table of contents remains correct, so the two accuracy behaviors are separate.

requirements.title: Table of Contents Accuracy
requirements.definition: Finalize the table of contents after pagination and ensure its article listings and page numbers match the completed magazine.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers table-of-contents information accuracy and sequencing; interactive hyperlink behavior was freelancer-initiated and is not included without clearer client adoption.

requirements.title: Digital Flipbook Output
requirements.definition: Produce the finalized PDF artifact suitable for use as the digital magazine flipbook.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers generation and delivery of the flipbook-ready PDF; platform branding and spread compatibility are independently testable.

requirements.title: Flipbook Spread Compatibility
requirements.definition: Prepare pagination that remains balanced in two-page flipbook spreads, including an even total page count where required.
requirements.boundary_note: Spread behavior and even pagination can fail independently of PDF delivery or platform branding.

requirements.title: Flipbook Platform Configuration
requirements.definition: Use the selected flipbook platform and configuration for publication, including the agreed treatment of platform branding and client-managed upload.
requirements.boundary_note: Provider choice, white-label branding, and upload ownership are coupled configuration attributes; the underlying flipbook PDF remains a separate deliverable.

requirements.title: Print-Ready Magazine Output
requirements.definition: Produce a press-quality print PDF with appropriate resolution, trim, bleed, and safe content placement when the print deliverable is in scope.
requirements.boundary_note: Print preparation is an independent output that was later removed from the active assignment; it must not be merged into the continuing digital flipbook requirement.

requirements.title: Source Template Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver the reusable magazine template and associated editable source files to the client.
requirements.boundary_note: Creating and using the template belongs to layout production, while handing over editable source files is a separate deliverable that can be requested independently.

requirements.title: Article Image Quality
requirements.definition: Ensure article and editorial images are sufficiently clear for the magazine, improving or replacing low-resolution images when necessary.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers image-resolution remediation; filling article-end whitespace and rendering advertisements are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Advertisement Rendering Quality
requirements.definition: Render supplied advertisements sharply and size them so their text and graphics remain within appropriate page safety boundaries.
requirements.boundary_note: Advertisement sharpness and page-safe sizing have a distinct failure and repair trajectory from general editorial image quality.

requirements.title: Future Article Word-Count Guidance
requirements.definition: Provide page-layout word-count targets for subsequent issues so article content can be prepared to avoid excessive empty space.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a future editorial-layout acceptance input, not the immediate correction mechanism for whitespace in the current issue.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer identified punctuation inconsistencies, but the client requested clarification rather than clearly requiring comprehensive copyediting; no independent copyediting Requirement can be established safely.
